key_reasoning.reason: Touches multiple subsystems: assistant versioning (assistant_version_service.py, assistant_version_compare_service.py, assistant_version_migration_service.py), tool execution gating (tool_execution_service.py), default toolkit assembly (toolkit_service.py, tools_info_service.py), and the code toolkit itself (code_toolkit.py, tools_vars.py) plus a new REST model field and DB migration — core shared services (toolkit_service.py, tool_execution_service.py) used by all assistants are modified.

No exact precedent for the alias-mapping gate added in tool_execution_service.py (DESELECTABLE_TOOL_NAME_BY_ALIAS) that must stay consistent with toolkit_service.py's default-tool assembly gating; a follow-up commit ('Fix V2 tool suppression and migration backfill from code review') shows the V1/V2 tool-name aliasing and migration backfill were not right on the first pass. The alembic migration backfills existing rows to avoid None-valued deselected_default_tools breaking unguarded `in`/`not in` checks at chat time — a data migration with a real rollback path (downgrade drops the columns).

diffstat reports 17 files changed (788 insertions, 14 deletions), which maps to the XXL band (16+) per the file-count rule; files span src/codemie/agents/tools/code/, src/codemie/rest_api/models/, src/codemie/service/assistant/, src/codemie/service/tools/, src/external/alembic/versions/, and multiple tests/ directories.

Touches DB-Persistence (alembic migration adding deselected_default_tools to assistants and assistant_configurations), the REST/data model layer (Assistant, AssistantConfiguration in assistant.py), and the Service layer (versioning, migration, compare, tool execution, toolkit assembly services) — three distinct layers including a schema migration.
